_about: 7 Nov 2026 (unreleased): the NeuroNet windows as full screens and the pause (docs NEURONET_PLAN.md). The nn_pause row.

rows.label: NeuroNet pauses the game
rows.help: In single player, in space, the world stops while a NeuroNet window (log, map, inventory, status, info) is open, and PAUSED shows. Off keeps the game going behind the windows. The autopilot flying keeps it going either way.
